theme: An open Saturday in Portland, two booking windows closing in
greeting: A rare clear Saturday, Dan - nothing on the calendar until the Black Keys at noon. The only real pull today is a couple of travel bookings whose windows are closing this week.

needsAttention.title: Pick the December destination
needsAttention.detail: Your task to shortlist and book the December break for all four kids is due to book by Oct 15 - five days out. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so the slip from the Sept 30 decision date is starting to cost.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The p1 task flags a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week - thin holiday inventory that reliably sells out. Booking refundable now holds the slot for nothing; it has been open since mid-September.

needsAttention.title: Drive the Pathfinder south
needsAttention.detail: The Portland-to-St Pete drive sits in its Oct 5-18 off-week window and you are in Maine right now. The window closes in just over a week, and a hotel night needs booking once the two days are set.

flagged.title: Fran Philip is waiting on you
flagged.detail: She replied Friday - happy with sushi as long as there are cooked options - and is waiting on you to lock the restaurant for next Friday's 12:30 lunch.

inbox.noise: About a dozen newsletters and shop promos - FT, the St. Pete and Midcoast locals, SoFi, and a few home and kitchen stores.

recipe.title: Quinces Poached in Muscat
recipe.why: Quinces come into their fragrant autumn best now, and a slow poach draws out their perfume.

Portland house order - bedframe + shower soap holder

acts.line: A slow, open morning in Portland - nothing on the calendar before noon.
The Black Keys take the State Theatre at noon, and the afternoon stays loose after that.
A quiet night, with the 15-minute Sunday review with Mike waiting first thing tomorrow.
